text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Run!! Run, run, run!! Don't think about the pain! Don't think about the suffering!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Don't stop, run!!
In order to become stronger—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...No, that's wrong!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ngh, waaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Right now, right here! ...Be stronger than anyone else!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAHHH...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...! Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy delivered a magnificent run.
Her profile was filled with a certain conviction.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Ah... it's really there.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Right now, within my hands...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...My strength lies right here—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Zenno Rob Roy brilliantly dashed through the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer... Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
It's a story of a hero named "Rob Roy."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: A book about a real hero who shares my name.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To sum up this "Rob Roy" briefly,
it's the story of Rob, an outlaw hero who rebels
against those in power, like nobles and royalty, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: There's a noble named Montrose who appears throughout the work as the protagonist's rival.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Montrose fought for over ten years trying to capture Rob Roy, but in the end, it was never settled...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy makes his escape,
vanishing from the battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I've always loved Rob Roy
and looked up to her, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Lately, I've found myself
thinking of Montrose quite often.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Having an opponent disappear before the contest is even decided is just so... Yes, it's very—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Because I believe it must be painful.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I went
to watch your Tenno Sho (Autumn), Kris S-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAHH!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—They've traded places, they've traded places!
Symboli Kris S has finally taken the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The second place runner is also closing in!
But still, it's Symboli Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S!! Overcoming it all, she achieves the first-ever back-to-back Tenno Sho (Autumn) victories in history!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
He's done it! Back-to-back Autumn Tenno Sho victories!!
The Jet-Black Emperor has finally accomplished it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Kris S-san...! Kris S-san, Kris S-san, —ah...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(You are so strong, so noble,
a true hero, and... that's why!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Please wait for me.
At the next Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I will make it there.
I promise you, I definitely will.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san.
I swear, I will definitely race against you...!!
